positive_snippets:
Excellent guest house with beautiful, clean, and well-maintained rooms.
Outstanding service, polite and helpful staff.
Hygiene is top-class, and the atmosphere is peaceful and comfortable.
Great facilities and wonderful hospitality.
Highly recommended for a pleasant and memorable stay!
negative_snippets:
Rooms were neat and OK. Not very spacy for the money.
But the staff is very very very rude .
We had confirmed with them the day before that we would reach 2-3 hrs earlier than checkin and they told it was okay and there is waiting area.
When we reached there they started asking for money.
They asked me to cancel the booking which was paid already INR 8228.
They asked to pay 10k and cancel the booking and giving reasons like tariff per person if they allow us into the rooms 2 hr before checkin.
We had 2 babies and they made us feed them in the lobby and didn't  even allow any washroom.
They made us wait there while the babies were crying out loud.
They also had problems with other customers in the name of money.
Stay was good but the people and staff of the hotel has no humanity and only intend to loot money from tourists in the name of fake government rules.
They complex doesn't have any lift as well, very difficult to carry luggages.

Reviews are misleading,
Basis stuff like water, water heating kettle, dustbins in room are missing, bath towels are not clean...
Worst service and hospitality.. receptionist talk to you rudely and won't understand.
